questions.text: Driver/Rider Availability: Reliable access to transport: (1) Average wait time (peak vs off-peak); (2) Coverage area (urban vs peri-urban); (3) Driver supply management (surge pricing transparency); (4) Cancellation rates (by driver); (5) Acceptance rates; (6) Backup options if no match; (7) Service during bad weather/night.
questions.evidence_required: Wait time analytics, Coverage maps, Cancellation logs
questions.africa_specific_notes: Peri-urban areas often underserved. Drivers refuse trips to 'unsafe' areas at night. Surge pricing during rain can be 5x.

questions.text: Matching Algorithm Accuracy: Getting the right driver: (1) Proximity accuracy (GPS drift); (2) ETA accuracy; (3) Route optimization (avoiding traffic/bad roads); (4) Driver-passenger matching logic (ratings); (5) Handling of offline drivers; (6) Multi-stop optimization (delivery).
questions.evidence_required: Algorithm documentation, ETA accuracy stats, GPS accuracy tests
questions.africa_specific_notes: GPS often inaccurate (poor satellite coverage, fake GPS). Roads not on maps. Traffic data unreliable.

questions.text: Vehicle Roadworthiness: Safe vehicles: (1) Inspection certificate verification; (2) Age limits (vehicle year); (3) Maintenance records; (4) Tire condition checks; (5) Brake functionality; (6) Seatbelt availability; (7) Fire extinguisher/first aid kit.
questions.evidence_required: Inspection certs, Vehicle age distribution, Maintenance logs
questions.africa_specific_notes: Many vehicles are 15+ years old. Inspection certs often forged. Boda-bodas (motorcycles) rarely have helmets for passengers.

questions.text: Driver Licensing & Vetting: Qualified drivers: (1) Driving license verification; (2) Criminal background check; (3) Driving record check (accidents/violations); (4) Age requirements; (5) Medical fitness (eyesight); (6) Periodic re-verification; (7) Suspension mechanism for violations.
questions.evidence_required: Vetting SOPs, License verification logs, Background check reports
questions.africa_specific_notes: Fake licenses common. Background checks often manual (no digital databases). Re-verification rare.

questions.text: On-Time Delivery Performance: Reliability of delivery: (1) On-time delivery rate; (2) ETA accuracy; (3) Delay notification; (4) Reasons for delays (traffic, weather, rider issues); (5) Compensation for late delivery; (6) Peak hour performance; (7) Rural vs urban performance.
questions.evidence_required: Delivery performance reports, Delay analysis, Compensation logs
questions.africa_specific_notes: Traffic jams are unpredictable. Address systems often poor (no street names). Riders call for directions.

questions.text: Order Accuracy & Condition: Correct delivery: (1) Order accuracy (right items); (2) Condition on arrival (food temperature, package integrity); (3) Tamper-evident packaging; (4) Photo proof of delivery; (5) Handling of fragile items; (6) Cold chain for perishables.
questions.evidence_required: Order accuracy stats, Customer complaints, Photo delivery logs
questions.africa_specific_notes: Riders sometimes eat food (hunger). Packaging often poor. Photo proof helps disputes.

questions.text: App Stability & Offline Capability: Platform uptime: (1) App crash rate; (2) Booking success rate; (3) Offline mode (can driver see trip details offline?); (4) Payment processing reliability; (5) GPS tracking continuity; (6) Low-bandwidth performance; (7) Support for USSD fallback.
questions.evidence_required: App crash logs, Booking failure rates, Offline mode specs
questions.africa_specific_notes: Network drops mid-trip. Drivers need offline access to trip details. USSD backup for feature phone users.

questions.text: Payment Settlement Reliability: Drivers get paid: (1) Settlement frequency (daily/weekly); (2) Settlement accuracy (no missing trips); (3) Transparency of deductions (commission, penalties); (4) Dispute resolution time; (5) Mobile money integration reliability; (6) Cash handling protocols; (7) Float management (for cash trips).
questions.evidence_required: Settlement logs, Dispute resolution stats, Mobile money transaction success rates
questions.africa_specific_notes: Drivers depend on daily earnings. Missing trips in settlement causes huge distrust. Cash still dominant in many markets.

scoring_notes: Layer 1 (Reliability) for Transport in SSA: Vehicle safety and driver vetting are life-safety issues. Payment settlement reliability determines driver retention. GPS/mapping accuracy is a major technical challenge.
